onset.Description: stimulus onset (t = 0 of the authors' time base TD) of this epoch in the concatenated file

trial_type.Description: readable condition built from the DETS columns; for the context task the condition identifiers of the OSF 'Details of the dataset' document (ORI 1 = 45 deg, ORI 2 = 135 deg, Sz 1 = 4 deg, Sz 2 = 6 deg as stated there; the paper's Methods give 60 and 150 deg for the central grating orientations)

check_position_index.Description: index of the checkerboard position in the 11 x 11 grid (DETS)

spatial_frequency.Description: grating spatial frequency (DETS; the paper's standard is 1 cycle/degree)

contrast.Description: grating contrast (DETS; values 1-100; the paper gives contrasts as Michelson contrast in percent, standard 80%)

correct.Description: DETS column 'Correct' (OSF document: [Electrode, Difficulty, Target, Session, Condition number, Correct]); values 0, 1 and 2 occur and the document gives no code list

epoch_index.Description: 0-based index of the epoch in this file

epoch_start.Description: time of the epoch's first sample in this file

epoch_end.Description: time of the epoch's last sample in this file

sample.Description: 0-based sample index of stimulus onset in this file
